title: BSC Audit Engine: Fail-Closed Audit-Descent Kernel
description: Version 0.3.0-alpha.9 is a public research preview of a fail-closed structural checker for typed scientific claims. It reconciles the compact Quick contract, four bilingual conversation starters, literal LaTeX and control-byte protections, documentation and privacy lint, generated package consistency, and quieter continuous integration without weakening release checks. The public GPT produces bounded human-readable audits and does not generate downloadable machine records, compiler output, hashes, Base64, shards, parity, transport, or section 10. The repository preserves the artifact compiler, controller, and historical 39-case transport evaluation as supervised standalone tooling and evidence; those components separate candidate failure, invalid-controller trials, and unresolved transport identity without granting proof or deployment authority. The package adds no Action or verification API. ChatGPT uploads are processed under the user's applicable terms and settings and are not local-only. A clear run means only that no implemented blocking condition fired on the declared input. This metadata applies to the Apache-2.0 software release assets; research material under research/ is separately governed by CC BY 4.0.
